blurb: Experience what it was like to go to school in a two-room schoolhouse, in the Little White School near downtown in Mission Park. Step back in time with one of our interpreters to 1948 when the school first opened. Book a personal tour (by appointment), visit the school as part of a community group gathering or rent the space for a private function.
